Main reading: a newline character followed by 'Okay' in text[:60]. alt_measured: 'Okay' anywhere in text[:60] (catches texts that start with 'Okay' with no newline before it). A literal backslash-n reading is not computed (only 2 T3 rows have a literal backslash-n in text[:60]). 21 T3 rows have empty text; they stay in and score 0. Problems with k in {2,3} and problems without exactly 4 attempt-0 rows are dropped. The bootstrap resamples problems (score, group) pairs; a resample with an empty group would take the full-sample value (unlikely to happen at these group sizes). n = problems in E plus H; group sizes are in example_row._groups. refuted_by is null, so refuted_by_met is always false. If a group is empty the script prints not_computable (the recipe says report nothing).

No self-open filter. a = T3-wrong rate among P-wrong problems, b = among P-right problems; statistic a - b. alt_measured: the same contrast with wrong = v3 score 0 only (cap_hit not forced wrong in either file); the recipe is explicit, so this is only a check of how much the 65 P cap hits and 8 T3 cap hits move it. P-wrong is likely a small group, so the interval may be wide; a resample with an empty conditioning group would take the full-sample value. n = problems in the set; group sizes are in example_row._groups (example_row is the T3 row of the first problem, text truncated).
